The '''Isde Naha system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isde Naha/Legends|Isde Naha]]. Between [[1004 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-held [[Realspace/Legends|space]], while at some point by [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] Isde Naha had become a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]]. Generations later, the planet in turn became the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the newly established Yarith [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Several parties related to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] traveled through the Isde Naha system in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], as did the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as part of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around that [[Time/Legends|time]].

==Description==
The Isde Naha system was situated in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was a part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Togominda system/Legends|Togominda system]] and the neighboring [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector's]] [[Ozu system/Legends|Ozu system]], while the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Bettel system/Legends|Bettel system]] as well as the [[Abridon system/Legends|Abridon system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[Star/Legends|star]] system contained the terrestrial<ref name="Rough">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325adv|text=Rough and Tundra|int=Rough and Tundra}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Isde Naha/Legends|same name]],<ref name="GG" /> which was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrialized world]] that served as the Yarith [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Post-Mugaari===
[[File:AnoatSectorMap.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Merchants from Isde Naha attempted to discover new trade routes through the Ivax and Kiax Nebulae.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the Isde Naha system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], with the system being situated in territory under the control of members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] between [[1004 BBY]] and 1000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], during the [[Light and Darkness War|final phase]] of their [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]-long [[New Sith Wars|conflict]] against the Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> After the Republic's victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately 1000 BBY and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" />

Launching from the Javin sector's newly [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] worlds such as Isde Naha, Republic [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] unsuccessfully attempted to discover shortcut trade routes through the region's [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]&mdash;the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax]] and [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]]&mdash;that would better connect the civilizations of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] and [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiins]] to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Such hyperlanes were ultimately established through the efforts of the entrepreneur [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]].<ref name="GG" />

===Later Republic reign===
[[File:EcclessisFiggStatue-JoY.png|thumb|right|250px|Lord Ecclessis Figg (statue pictured) played an important role in the history of the Isde Naha system.]]
Figg's achievements in the exploration of the region also included the blazing of a [[Nothoiin Route|new route]] that connected the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] hyperlane to<ref name="GG" /> the Lipsec Run<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;and therefore eventually to the Corellian Trade Spine at the Isde Naha system. The discovery accelerated the development of the more backwater areas of the Javin sector. In the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of Figg's life,<ref name="GG" /> around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the sector containing the Isde Naha system was re-designated as the new Anoat sector, and generations after that, the Anoat itself was further split into two parts, with the star system becoming a part of the Yarith sector.<ref name="GG" />

Although the Isde Naha system lay outside the Republic's borders during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TEA" /> during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] was nevertheless tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the system's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Isde Naha system was featured on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:LukeESB-OP.png|thumb|left|250px|On two occasions during the Galactic Civil War, the Jedi trainee Luke Skywalker traveled through the Isde Naha system.]]
Following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled from the Anoat sector's [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] to the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]] of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in order to undergo further [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] his [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Skywalker transited the Isde Naha system on the way to the Dagobah system. Later, the Jedi passed through the same system on a return journey to the Anoat sector that he undertook in order to rescue his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&ndash;aligned friends after witnessing them being in danger via a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] subsequently likewise traveled through the Isde Naha system while journeying to a [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous]] with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="TEA" />

Also not long after the Battle of Hoth, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Clabburn the Younger]] and [[Salmakk]] launched a series of raids in the Greater Javin, capturing several raw material [[Transport/Legends|transports]] of the local company [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]]. Due to it already harboring suspicions about the company's loyalty, the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], of which Figg Excavations was a member, launched a security investigation into the matter, dispatching a team of its paramilitary [[Guild Enforcers]] to the region. The leader of the Enforcer team, [[Fannis Gult]], was based on Isde Naha, though her impatience motivated her to leave that world and be more directly involved in the investigation.<ref name="Rough" />

While moving [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] as part of secondary movements of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of the galaxy in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] species traveled through the Isde Naha system. Later that year, the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the Rebel Alliance's successor, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], also advanced Coreward through that system as part of the continued Galactic Civil War against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The population of the Isde Naha system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Isde Naha system was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] named the system and placed it in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
